gaps: Region, area and division leaders are not fully confirmed: several HBA and state-registry sites were not read, and most rows rest on 2022 to 2024 local-press quotes (tagged Inferred) or a directory listing. The company itself names no region, area or division leaders on its sites, in its 10-K, or in any 2023 to 2026 press release (all 2023 to 2026 releases on investors.meritagehomes.com were checked).

Region presidents (West, Central, East): no company source. Best leads: Kyle Davison, Texas Region President from January 2025 (archived 2025 speaker bio, Reported); Steve Harding, 'Region President' with no region (directory); Darren Dupree, Area President Mountain West (snippets only). A search snippet of a ZoomInfo page named an 'Elliot Jones' as West Region President; not on the page when opened.

Reporting lines: not public. The 10-K says divisions are run by division management and every land deal goes to a corporate land acquisition committee, with larger deals also approved by Executive Chairman Steven Hilton. 2025 to 2026 job postings show division land VPs work to the Division President and prepare a corporate approval package. The COO seat has been vacant since Clint Szubinski left in May 2025; whether region presidents now report to CEO Phillippe Lord or to EVP Corporate Operations and Strategy Austin Woffinden is not stated.

Dallas/Fort Worth and Nashville: Austin Woffinden ran DFW (2018 to 2025) and was Area President of DFW and Nashville (2025) before moving to corporate on 1 January 2026; his successors are not named in any source opened.

Division and region land leaders: no 2025 or 2026 source names one. Older or unconfirmed names are carried as Inferred rows (Scott Loncki and Tyler Champlin in Phoenix, Brandon Hammond in Austin). Job postings 2025 to 2026 show open or recent land VP seats in Tampa, Greenville, Charleston, Salt Lake City (Sandy) and Dallas (Coppell), naming no one.

Unconfirmed 'Division President' names from directory snippets with no division given, not added as rows: Lexie McIntyre (another snippet says Region VP of Finance), Tucker Dorsey (snippet text mentions Colorado and Utah), John Meyer, David Aughinbaugh, Anthony Wyman; contact-directory listings (connectplex) also show Justin Cook, Jeremy Flach, Pat Murphy and Dave Bulloch as Meritage division presidents, but Justin Cook joined PulteGroup as Northeast Florida division president in May 2023 (https://www.whatsupjacksonville.com/pultegroup-names-justin-cook-president-of-northeast-florida-division/, previously Meritage South Florida division president), which shows these listings are stale.

HBA board seats held for Meritage in 2026 with no title published: Fei Zue (HBA of Metro Denver, https://www.hbadenver.com/officers-and-board-of-directors/), Scott Kolt (Southern Arizona HBA, Tucson, https://sahba.org/who-we-are/our-team/), Chiara Basso (BIA Bay Area board, ex-officio DRE chair, https://www.biabayarea.org/board-of-directors). Likely local leaders, titles not confirmed, so not added as rows.

Stale names, not added as rows: Fred Hermann, Phoenix division president (2016 to October 2022 articles); Jeff Grobstein, regional president (March 2021); Jeremy Flach, San Antonio (2021); Steve Hahn, Greenville (2017); Elliot Mann, Southern California (2018); Michael Iles-Cremieux, regional VP land acquisition (2013).
